meta.title: UTMB 2026 — Plan B Detail
meta.subtitle: Champex → Orsières → Trient → Vallorcine · Sat 29 Aug night · Swiss pass + IDs for the border

route.title: The road — two buses, one col, one border

segments.detail: 25 min · every 30 min · downhill out of the lake bowl
45 min · every 30 min on :15/:45 · runs until SUN 04:00 · via Sembrancher and Martigny, then the Col de la Forclaz hairpins (1,526 m)
15 min · every 30 min on :00/:30 · runs until SUN 09:00 · crosses the Châtelard border back into France — bring IDs
3-min walk from the station to the checkpoint zone

variants.label: B1 — straight through
steps: Trient → Vallorcine bus (15 min) — a same-minute 20:30 meet may work, ask the driver
Vallorcine — ~3h20 early. Dinner at Le Café Comptoir.
variants.note: The certain meal. Kitchen window is yours until ~22:00–23:00.

variants.label: B2 — linger in Trient, see him twice
steps: Arrive Trient. Bar food / coffee at Auberge du Mont-Blanc (to ~22:00)
CHEER SUHA through CP12 Trient — no assistance allowed, cheering only
Bus → Vallorcine, arrive 23:15/23:45 — still 50+ min before him
SUHA at CP13 — window 00:15–00:55, hand over 190 g carbs
variants.note: Decide at Orsières — both variants ride the same buses until Trient.

places.name: UTMB checkpoint buvettes
places.detail: village food stands usually run on race night at Trient and Vallorcine — UNVERIFIED, treat as bonus not plan

footer: Buses run until SUN 04:00 (Orsières→Trient) and SUN 09:00 (Trient→Vallorcine) — a slip never strands you; it only closes kitchens. Swiss pass covers all three bus legs; IDs for the Châtelard border.
